packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

Hold devalue below 6: SvelteKit 3 depends on devalue ^5.9.4, and its streaming serializer throws 'Invalid JavaScript fragment' under devalue 6. CI stays green unless a route streams a promise. Lift this once SvelteKit moves to devalue 6.

Open the group:allNonMajor PR once a week, in the lockFileMaintenance window (Monday before 4am UTC), and auto-merge it once CI passes. A group auto-merges only when every update in it does, so this covers production minors too. Security PRs ignore this schedule and the group: Renovate forces its vulnerabilityAlerts defaults onto them (#465).
